cues: Where do resistance genes come from?
Wild relatives and old landraces, which is why gene banks matter.
Nepal's mid hill terraces still hold rice and barley landraces with genes modern varieties have lost.
They are moved by the backcross method, by mutation breeding, or by genetic engineering, which can bring in a gene from any organism at all.
